summary: Put punctuation inside quotation marks, use only 'said' or 'says', and place the speaker's name right after the quote.
questions: Does punctuation go inside or outside quotes in Ansible style?
How should I attribute a quote?

answer_card.title: Quotations
answer_card.answer_md: Punctuation goes **inside** the quotes. Use only "said" or "says", with the name first: `"...," Wally Lamb said.`
